negative_abuse_invariant.rule: Merely changing inquiry status to 'confirmed' produces zero revenue in the financial ledger without verified settlement.
negative_abuse_invariant.enforcement: Financial summary queries rbpc_settlement_ledger only where status IN ('approved', 'settled'); inquiry status changes never insert or alter settlement revenue rows.
